summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to announce a regular quarterly cash distribution declared by its board of directors, with a record date of June 30, 2026 and payment on July 17, 2026. The distribution rates per share for its Classes A, D, I, P, and T common stock are $0.1042 gross, with net amounts after servicing fees for Classes D and T. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. This filing is a routine dividend announcement and does not constitute a special situation event.
